sources.title: Winners and Losers from the Denver Broncos’ 34-6 victory over the Minnesota Vikings
sources.description: The preseason is finally done! Next up, Kansas City. After a disappointing showing last week, the Broncos ended the preseason with a dominating 34-6 victory over the Vikings. It was a typical third preseason game that saw the vast majority of the starters sit out the game and the backups get some playing time in […]
